Photos show used rusty parts but no import or origin markers.

Close-up photos of logos, branding, or OEM part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket or unknown origin

risks.risk: Rust and wear severity hidden by the heap and watermark
risks.proof: Individual close-up photos of each part, especially bolt holes and bushings, without watermark.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of part numbers and casting marks on each component
Video showing the parts are not bent, cracked, or internally damaged
Import or purchase documents supporting Belgium origin
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as used suspension and steering parts, so it can be priced at its worst case; seller claims about origin and function cannot be proven from photos.
